candidates.name: uv (pip compile --generate-hashes)
candidates.fit_for_gap: Generates one hash-locked requirements file from pyproject.toml and its hosted and postgres extras, for pip install --require-hashes in the image build.
candidates.decision_rationale: Already installed on the operator's machine (0.11.9) and an untracked uv.lock exists in the checkout; used at lock time only, so the image build keeps plain pip.
risks: Lock must be regenerated on every dependency change; a CI check should fail when it is stale.
Platform-specific wheels: the lock must cover linux amd64 and arm64.

build_required.need: Persistent hosted configuration and a restarted-by-Kubernetes heartbeat
build_required.why_no_candidate: Sellbird's own manifests and hosted-mode code.

build_required.need: Migration Job that works on a fresh install
build_required.why_no_candidate: Sellbird's own Argo CD hook ordering.

build_required.need: Deploy gated on green tests; image ID recorded before scans; Trivy checksum and failing-scan control
JWKS https rule, DNS policy for NodeLocal DNSCache, F1-F3
build_required.why_no_candidate: Small fixes in Sellbird's own code and manifests.
